agriculture.name: Agriculture
agriculture.flavor: The first furrow is the first calendar.

husbandry.name: Husbandry
husbandry.flavor: A horse is a decision arrived at sooner.

sailing.name: Sailing
sailing.flavor: The shore stops being the edge of the world.

mining.name: Mining
mining.flavor: The hill is asked what it is made of.

earthenware.name: Pottery
earthenware.flavor: What the jar keeps, the year forgets.

bronzeWorking.name: Bronzeworking
bronzeWorking.flavor: Two soft metals agree to become a hard one.

stonecraft.name: Stonecraft
stonecraft.flavor: Stone remembers longer than any of us.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.flavor: The year, cut into pieces small enough to plan.

divination.name: Divination
divination.flavor: We question the sky, and learn the habit of questions.
divination.note: A shrine is where a people first listen, and the first of your gods arrives of its own accord once the realm's faith runs deep enough.

letters.name: Writing
letters.flavor: A thought that outlives the mouth it came from.

theWheel.name: The Wheel
theWheel.flavor: Nobody expected the circle to be useful.
theWheel.note: Every worker made from now on has an extra charge of work. Chariots may be trained if you have improved horses or camels.

siegecraft.name: Siegecraft
siegecraft.flavor: A wall is only a promise about time.
siegecraft.note: Your soldiers may besiege an enemy town: a town they surround cannot heal and loses health each turn. Towns may raise stone walls, and workers may build lumber mills.

irrigation.name: Irrigation
irrigation.flavor: Water is taught where to go.
irrigation.note: A farm standing beside fresh water feeds its city better than it did.

wayfinding.name: Wayfinding
wayfinding.flavor: The stars are a coastline nobody can move.

epicPoetry.name: Epic Poetry
epicPoetry.flavor: The dead are given a metre, and stop being dead.
epicPoetry.note: Renown now brings great people. Before you know this, renown still builds up, but no great person comes.

currency.name: Currency
currency.flavor: A promise small enough to carry.

kingship.name: Code of Laws
kingship.flavor: One name at the top of the list, and a list.
kingship.note: A city may put its labour into pageants, and what it raises is celebration rather than stone. The crown's authority reaches further too: your realm may hold more cities in hand than it could.

theLongCount.name: Chronology
theLongCount.flavor: A calendar long enough to outlast the people keeping it.
theLongCount.note: You may spend faith to draw a new hand of Orders in place of the one you were offered.

stateWorkforce.name: State Workforce
stateWorkforce.flavor: A season the realm owns, taken from each in turn.
stateWorkforce.note: Every worker made from now on has an extra charge of work.

theHighTemple.name: The High Temple
theHighTemple.flavor: A roof high enough that the god has to look down through it.

bronzePanoply.name: Bronze Panoply
bronzePanoply.flavor: A shield is only a wall if it stands beside another.
bronzePanoply.note: Phalanxes and swordsmen may be trained if you have improved copper or obsidian. When you do, your spearmen become phalanxes and your warriors become swordsmen. Iron now shows on the map.

shipwrights.name: Shipwrights
shipwrights.flavor: A hull is a house that has agreed to be wet.

philosophy.name: Rhetoric
philosophy.flavor: First we ask what a thing is; the asking never stops.

paperMoney.name: Paper Money
paperMoney.flavor: A note that is worth something because everyone agrees it is.
paperMoney.note: Notes, ledgers and a floor to shout them across: the realm's coin can be turned into song at the Bourse.

artisanry.name: Guildhalls
artisanry.flavor: The guild decides what a thing is worth by how long it took.

mathematics.name: Mathematics
mathematics.flavor: The siege begins as a diagram.

theImperialPost.name: Satrapies
theImperialPost.flavor: The message arrives before the rumour does.
theImperialPost.note: Opens the Forbidden City and the Great Wall.

theExaminationHall.name: The Civil Service
theExaminationHall.flavor: The clerk is chosen by the paper, not by the father.
theExaminationHall.note: A town you have taken by force may build a Courthouse.

colonialCharters.name: Daughter Cities
colonialCharters.flavor: A city, written down before it is built.
colonialCharters.note: Every town you found starts with its Town Charter already built.

theology.name: Theology
theology.flavor: The library, copied by candlelight, one page a day.
theology.note: The enhancing beliefs open here: a faith may now be deepened as well as spread.

ironWorking.name: Iron Working
ironWorking.flavor: Every age is named for what it kills with.
ironWorking.note: Legionaries and spear walls may be trained. Your phalanxes become spear walls. When you have improved iron, your swordsmen become legionaries.

education.name: Scholarship
education.flavor: A school is a city’s second memory.

horology.name: Horology
horology.flavor: The hour stops being a guess.
horology.note: Opens the Water Clock of Su Song.

engineering.name: Engineering
engineering.flavor: The river is put to work and does not complain.

theCataphract.name: The Saddle
theCataphract.flavor: Man and horse, both in iron, both surprised by it.
theCataphract.note: Horsemen, horse archers and war elephants may be trained, and every pasture your towns work gives more production.

prospecting.name: Geomancy
prospecting.flavor: The hill is asked again, and this time it answers.
prospecting.note: Every mine your towns work gives more production. Workers and scouts may also search a hill for a buried seam.

silkRoad.name: The Silk Road
silkRoad.flavor: Nobody has walked it. Everything has.
silkRoad.note: Towns may build a Caravanserai, which lets your empire run more trade routes.

banking.name: The Counting Houses
banking.flavor: Somebody else’s promise, kept in a strongroom.

machinery.name: Machinery
machinery.flavor: A crank is a servant that never sleeps.

theAstrolabe.name: The Astrolabe
theAstrolabe.flavor: The sky is held at arm’s length and measured.

theSilkRoad.name: The Golden Roads
theSilkRoad.flavor: No one walks all of it; the cloth does.
theSilkRoad.note: Your empire may run an extra trade route at once.

feudalism.name: Castellany
feudalism.flavor: Everyone kneels to someone and calls it order.
feudalism.note: Towns may build a Castle, and pikemen may be trained.

theHolyOffice.name: The Holy Office
theHolyOffice.flavor: The question is asked, and it is not really a question.

steel.name: Steel
steel.note: Longswordsmen may be trained, and towns may build a Forge.

alchemy.name: Alchemy
alchemy.flavor: The stone is never found; everything else is.
alchemy.note: Niter is named, and the first soldier who carries fire may be trained where it is dug. Completing this pays a glass bead, and the first empire in the world to complete it opens the Magnum Opus for everybody.

movableType.name: Movable Type
movableType.flavor: One carved character, used a thousand times.
movableType.note: Opens the Printing House, which makes the town that holds it learn and build faster.

militantOrders.name: Militant Orders
militantOrders.flavor: Vows taken twice: once at the altar, once in the saddle.

herbals.name: Herbals
herbals.flavor: Every weed has a use, once someone writes it down.

casting.name: Casting
casting.flavor: Pour the bronze while it is bright, and the mould keeps the shape.

surveying.name: Surveying
surveying.flavor: Measure the fall of the land, and the water follows the line.

cataloguing.name: Cataloguing
cataloguing.flavor: A book nobody can find is a book nobody has.

optics.name: Optics
optics.flavor: A curve of glass, and the far thing comes near.

medicine.name: Medicine
medicine.flavor: First the ward for the sick, then the school beside it.

scholasticism.name: Scholasticism
scholasticism.flavor: Faith asks a question, and reason is allowed to answer it.

papermaking.name: Papermaking
papermaking.flavor: Rags in the vat, and a page for every hand.

printing.name: Printing
printing.flavor: Set the page once, and print it a thousand times.

mechanics.name: Mechanics
mechanics.flavor: Gears teach patience to the arm that turns them.

gunfounding.name: Gunfounding
gunfounding.flavor: The founders cast the guns, and the guns redraw the borders.

chemistry.name: Chemistry
chemistry.flavor: Weigh what goes in, weigh what comes out, and trust the scale.

militaryArchitecture.name: Military Architecture
militaryArchitecture.flavor: Angle the walls, and no stretch of stone is left unseen.

navalGunnery.name: Naval Gunnery
navalGunnery.flavor: A row of guns turns a galley into a moving fort.

riteOfTheHarvest.name: Rite of the Harvest
riteOfTheHarvest.summary: A city may keep this rite a while: every hex it works that feeds it feeds it more.

omenReading.name: Omen Reading
omenReading.summary: A city may keep this rite a while: every building standing in it adds a little learning.

consecrationOfTheBounds.name: Consecration of the Bounds
consecrationOfTheBounds.summary: A city may keep this rite a while: its luxury hexes sing and its bounds walk outward faster.

blessingOfArms.name: Blessing of Arms
blessingOfArms.summary: A city may keep this rite a while: it is harder to storm.

riteOfPlenty.name: Rite of Plenty
riteOfPlenty.summary: A city may keep this rite a while: every hex it works with a seam in it pays a little coin.

militaryEmbark.name: Sea Legs
militaryEmbark.summary: Soldiers may cross coastal water and lakes.

siege.name: Siege
siege.summary: Surrounded enemy cities cannot heal and lose health each turn.

theLongCount.name: The Long Count
theLongCount.summary: You may spend faith to redraw an Order draft.

oceanGoing.name: Open Ocean
oceanGoing.summary: Ships and embarked units may cross deep ocean.

openBorders.name: Open Borders
openBorders.summary: Open-borders treaties; both empires must know Writing.

votiveOffering.name: Votive Offering
votiveOffering.summary: A city may give faith to whatever it is building: the faith the rite costs becomes production.

restoringOfTheHost.name: Restoring of the Host
restoringOfTheHost.summary: A city may spend faith to heal every unit of yours standing in land that follows your religion.
